description: Consorzio BIM Vomano Tordino di Teramo publishes school-facility registers for the 2024–2025 and 2025–2026 academic years. The descriptions state that the CSV files list all schools in the consortium territory, with school code, name, school type, address, municipality, province, region and postal code. The two annual snapshots are grouped as one inventory. Public access is free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. These facility identities and addresses can support school-service location and capacity-planning inputs, but the source does not report pupil capacity, building condition or emergency readiness. The native internal identifiers contain an older Tortoreto wording, while the titles, descriptions and geographic metadata declare consortium-wide coverage; the actual file coverage was not checked. The public metadata listing remains the access route because individual API routes returned HTTP 404. Related regional school resources are not assumed identical without an upstream identity link.
